description:
"Meaning:
of / possessive particle (indicates possessive)
When の is placed between two nouns it can act as a possessive
particle. の is a particle used to indicate possession.This is similar to
the English possessive " 's ".
Noun A の Noun B = Noun A's Noun B

Formation:
Noun 1 + の + Noun 2"
